title: Moment Map Pairing Formulas
body_html:
Moment Map Pairing Formulas

For \(w,w_1,w_2\in W\), \(X\in\mathbf g\), and \(X'\in\mathbf g'\), the symplectic form and moment maps satisfy: \[ \langle w_1,w_2\rangle_W=\operatorname{tr}(w_2^\ast w_1), \] \[ \langle Xw,w\rangle_W=2B_{\mathbf g}(M(w),X), \] and the analogous formula on the \(G'\)-side, with the sign convention of the paper.
proof_html: The proof is a direct computation from the adjoint convention and the trace pairing. These identities are later used to translate oscillator characters into Moy-Prasad characters.
